style_snapshot.name: Deep Water Station
style_snapshot.generation_hints: Use a free-camera perspective-correct 3D viewpoint with a low-angle heroic upward tilt between 15–40° for exterior subjects, shifting to eye-level or slightly elevated (0–20°) for interiors, with natural depth of field and subtle lens distortion or chromatic aberration applied. Render in high-fidelity real-time PBR style consistent with Unreal Engine 5 — no outlines, no cel-shading, fully photorealistic edge treatment with natural anti-aliasing, physically-based metallic/roughness material pipeline, emissive lighting strips in cyan, red, and orange, and subsurface scattering on fabric or padded surfaces. Adhere strictly to this color palette: deep navy #0A1E3D, ocean teal #2D7A6E, sky blue #3BA8E0, aged gold #C4A832, warm sand #D6CDB8, burnt orange #D4943A, rust brown #8B4A2B, crimson red #C42020, and dark charcoal #2A2D30. Light from a dominant directional source casting sharp volumetric shadows with secondary ambient fill, suggesting deep underwater or industrial interior environments. Deliver AAA-quality detail with 2K–4K PBR texture sets including albedo, normal, metallic, roughness, AO, and emissive maps; surface micro-detail must include rivets, weld seams, bolt patterns, stenciled markings, edge wear, paint chipping, and barnacle or corrosion growth where appropriate.

analyzed_style.perspective: Free-camera 3D perspective with varied angles — predominantly low-angle heroic shots (15-40° upward tilt) for underwater exteriors, eye-level to slightly elevated (0-20°) for interior spaces, and one high isometric overview (~45° top-down) for the asset layout sheet. No fixed orthographic or dimetric projection; fully perspective-correct with depth of field in many shots.
analyzed_style.rendering: High-fidelity real-time PBR 3D rendering, likely Unreal Engine 4/5. Full physically-based material pipeline with metallic/roughness workflows. No outlines or cel-shading. Photorealistic edge treatment with natural anti-aliasing. Chromatic aberration and lens distortion post-processing applied to underwater exterior shots. Emissive materials used for lighting strips (cyan, red, orange). Subsurface scattering hints on padded/fabric elements.
analyzed_style.detail_level: AAA-quality high-detail assets. Dense polygon counts with smooth curvature on cylindrical pressure vessels, complex mechanical assemblies, and fabric simulation on seat cushions. Texture resolution appears 2K-4K per asset with full PBR map sets (albedo, normal, metallic, roughness, AO, emissive). Micro-detail includes: rivets, weld seams, bolt patterns, stenciled text/numbering, barnacle growth on underwater surfaces, scratches, paint chipping, and edge wear. Modular kit-piece construction visible in the overview image with standardized connection points.

details.value: Visible weld seams and rivet detail on armor plates, corrosion growth on metal buckles, stenciled markings on pauldrons, and subsurface scattering on padded vest surfaces.

setting.value: Industrial underwater or deep-sea military interior environment with rusted bulkheads, corroded pipes, and barnacle-encrusted structural beams.

background.value: Dark charcoal and deep navy industrial corridor with emissive cyan and orange lighting strips lining the walls, volumetric fog, and distant amber glow through a hatch opening.

time_of_day.value: Timeless interior — artificial lighting suggesting a tense, high-stakes mission atmosphere with deep shadow contrast.

camera_angle.value: Low-angle heroic upward tilt at approximately 25°, free-camera perspective-correct 3D viewpoint with subtle lens distortion and chromatic aberration at frame edges.

framing.value: Full-body to 3/4-body crop, subject centered with slight left offset, character occupying 65% of vertical frame height.

depth_of_field.value: Natural depth of field with sharp focus on the soldier's face and upper torso, soft bokeh falloff on background corridor elements.

key_light.value: Dominant directional key light from upper-front-left casting sharp volumetric shadows across the face and armor, warm burnt orange tone suggesting industrial flare.

fill_rim.value: Secondary ambient fill in ocean teal from below-right, emissive cyan rim light tracing the helmet and shoulder armor edges, crimson red accent bounce from background warning lights.

mood.value: Tense, cinematic, high-contrast industrial atmosphere with deep underwater undertones — dramatic and heroic.

art_style.value: High-fidelity real-time PBR rendering consistent with Unreal Engine 5 — fully photorealistic, no outlines, no cel-shading, natural anti-aliasing, physically-based metallic/roughness pipeline with emissive material channels.

quality.value: AAA-quality 2K–4K PBR texture sets including albedo, normal, metallic, roughness, AO, and emissive maps; micro-detail includes rivets, weld seams, bolt patterns, stenciled markings, edge wear, paint chipping, and barnacle or corrosion growth.
